connections_blocked_status_check.name: connections_blocked_status_check
connections_blocked_status_check.value: ("connections"."status" <> 'blocked') OR ("connections"."blocked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "connections"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL)

columns.expression:
to_tsvector('english', trim(regexp_replace(
        concat_ws(
            ' ',
            trim(regexp_replace(coalesce("content", ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')),
            trim(regexp_replace(coalesce("metadata" #>> '{structured,title}', ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')),
            trim(regexp_replace(coalesce("metadata" #>> '{structured,summary}', ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))
        ),
        '\s+',
        ' ',
        'g'
    )))

profile_project_contributions_verified_i.name: profile_project_contributions_verified_idx
profile_project_contributions_verified_i.where: "profile_project_contributions"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "profile_project_contributions"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL

user_notifications_read_age_idx.name: user_notifications_read_age_idx
user_notifications_read_age_idx.where: "user_notifications"."read_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_notifications"."dismissed_at" IS NULL
